svg.title: Publish a recording, a record and notes, not a facsimile
svg.text: What a public copy of a running system is made of
the first three cost a beat, a row or a picture per feature; the fourth costs a fixture, a template branch,
a dead-button note and a leak check per page, and it is the one the reader who checks learns to distrust
after the rule: 4 pages rendered (the stage, the CBOM viewer, the recorded answers, About), none with a dead control
